note: TENNIS zfix: Finals-qualification rule stated in the canonical ranking-points simulation input.

ten.ranking_points_simulation.mechanism: Rank and major-count markets are tails of points accumulated over a calendar of tournaments. Finals-qualification contracts (KXATPFINALSQUAL, KXWTAFINALSQUAL; filed under season_ranking_and_majors) are read off the calendar-year Race, which has no 52-week drop-offs, not off the rolling ranking: Race places 1-7 qualify and the eighth place goes to the highest-ranked current-year Grand Slam singles champion in Race places 8-20 who is not already in 1-7, else Race place 8 (rule recorded as verified for ATP and WTA in ten.remaining_race_arithmetic); withdrawal after qualifying does not change settlement ('If player qualifies but does not compete, the market resolves to Yes').
ten.ranking_points_simulation.measurement: Simulate remaining tournaments from own rating, entry probability and draw difficulty; track points added and dropped; output rank and major-count distributions. Finals qualification: run the same simulation on the calendar-year Race (no drop-offs) to the final pre-Finals Race list; P(Yes) = share of simulations in which the player is in the qualified set (Race places 1-7 plus the Slam-champion eighth place above); Race places 9-10 are alternates, and a promoted alternate is not counted as qualified unless a Kalshi precedent says otherwise (sr_finals_qual_contracts).
